description: React component for the checkout screen in a food delivery web application, managing order placement, address selection, payment, and UI rendering.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the restaurant is currently open based on current time and restaurant timings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates Apollo cache after a successful order placement, specifically for COD orders.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during order mutation, displaying error messages.

methods.name: calculateTip
methods.description: Calculates the tip amount based on selected tip percentage and total order cost.

methods.name: taxCalculation
methods.description: Calculates the tax amount based on tax rate and order total.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles post-order placement actions, including analytics tracking and navigation based on payment method.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates total price of cart items including delivery charges and discounts.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total order amount including items, tax, tip, and delivery charges.

methods.name: transformOrder
methods.description: Transforms cart data into order input format for mutation.

methods.name: checkPaymentMethod
methods.description: Validates if the selected payment method supports the current currency.

methods.name: onPayment
methods.description: Initiates the order mutation process after validating payment method and order details.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates all order conditions before proceeding to place the order.
